# Favorites Morocco Tours

> Favorites Morocco Tours (Favorites Morocco Tours LLC) is a Morocco travel agency based in Marrakech that organizes private tours with a private driver and local guides: Sahara desert tours (Merzouga, Erg Chebbi, Zagora), multi-day itineraries from Marrakech, Casablanca, Fes, Tangier and Errachidia, and day trips (Atlas Mountains, Ourika, Imlil, Ouzoud, Essaouira, Ait Ben Haddou, Agafay, Volubilis). The website is available in English, Spanish, Portuguese and Italian.

Booking: 20% deposit to confirm, the rest paid in Morocco. Free cancellation up to 14 days before departure.
Contact: contact@favoritesmoroccotours.com · WhatsApp +212 786 278 943 · Phone +1 614 858 5453

## Travel guides (EN; also in Spanish, Portuguese and Italian)
- [Trip to Morocco: How to Plan It Step by Step](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/trip-to-morocco/): Planning a trip to Morocco: how long to stay, the best time, routes, money, safety, what to pack and how to book a private tour, with a simple step-by-step checklist.
- [What to Do in Fes: 10 Best Things to See](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/what-to-do-in-fez-2/): What to do in Fes, Morocco: the old medina, the Chouara tannery, Bou Inania Madrasa, Bab Bou Jeloud, Fes el-Jdid and viewpoints, with tips and how many days to stay.
- [Excursions in Morocco: Best Day Trips](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/excursions-in-morocco-2/): The best excursions in Morocco: day trips from Marrakech to Ouzoud, Ourika, Imlil, Aït Benhaddou, Essaouira and Agafay, and from Fes to Volubilis. What to expect and how to book.
- [Marrakech Holidays: A Simple Planning Guide](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/marrakech-holidays/): Planning Marrakech holidays: how many days to stay, where to stay (medina riad, Gueliz or Palmeraie), the best sights, day trips and tips for a relaxed stay.
- [Tetouan, Morocco: What to See and How to Visit](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/tetouan-morocco/): Tetouan guide: the white UNESCO medina in northern Morocco, what to see, beaches nearby, how to get there from Tangier and Chefchaouen, and how long to stay.
- [Gates of the Marrakech Medina: A Visitor's Guide](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/gates-of-the-medina-of-marrakech/): The gates (bab) of the Marrakech medina: Bab Agnaou, Bab Doukkala, Bab El Khemis, Bab Debbagh and more, what each is known for and how to visit the old walls.
- [Morocco Tours from Spain: Ferry and Private Tours](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/morocco-tours-from-spain/): Morocco tours from Spain: cross by ferry from southern Spain to Tangier and start a private tour with a driver and guide. Routes, what to bring and how to book.
- [Where to Eat in Marrakech: A Simple Guide](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/restaurant-marrakech-guide/): Where to eat in Marrakech: street food at Jemaa el-Fna, rooftop and riad restaurants, cafés in Gueliz, local dishes to try and simple tips for eating well.
- [Things to Do in Morocco: 12 Best Activities](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/things-to-do-in-morocco/): The best things to do in Morocco: a night in the Sahara, Marrakech souks, Fes medina, Chefchaouen, Aït Benhaddou, Atlas hikes, a hammam and more, with where to go and how many days.
- [7 Days in Morocco: A One-Week Itinerary](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/7-days-in-morocco-itinerary/): A 7-day Morocco itinerary: Marrakech, the Atlas, Aït Benhaddou, the Sahara, Fes and more, with day-by-day stops and planning tips.
- [2 Weeks in Morocco: A 14-Day Itinerary](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/2-weeks-in-morocco-itinerary/): A 14-day Morocco itinerary: Tangier, Chefchaouen, Fes, the Sahara, the Dades Valley, Marrakech and the coast, with how long to stay and what to see.
- [Morocco Weather by Month: Climate and Where to Go](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/morocco-weather/): Morocco weather by month: approximate temperatures in Marrakech, desert heat and cold nights, the best seasons, rain and snow, and where to go in every month of the year.
- [Cities in Morocco: The Best Places to Visit](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/cities-in-morocco/): The best cities and places to visit in Morocco: Marrakech, Fes, Chefchaouen, Casablanca, Rabat, Tangier and Essaouira, with what each is known for and how many days to spend.
- [Flights to Morocco: Airports and Booking Tips](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/flights-to-morocco/): Flights to Morocco: the main airports (Marrakech, Casablanca, Fes, Tangier, Agadir and Rabat), which to choose for your route, and simple booking tips.
- [Where Is Morocco? Location and How to Get There](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/where-is-morocco/): Where is Morocco? A country in North Africa on the Atlantic and Mediterranean coasts, just 14 km from Spain, with regions, capital and how to travel there.
- [Private vs Group Tours in Morocco: Which Is Better?](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/private-vs-group-tours-in-morocco/): Private or group tour in Morocco? Compare flexibility, pace, comfort, cost and who each option suits, with a simple checklist to choose.
- [Morocco Tour Packages: Routes, What Is Included and How to Book](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/morocco-tour-packages/): Compare Morocco tour packages: private routes from Marrakech, Fes, Casablanca and Tangier, what is usually included, how to choose a trip and how to book with a written quote.
- [Morocco Currency: The Dirham Guide for Travellers](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/moroccan-dirham/): Morocco's currency is the dirham (MAD). Notes and coins, rough euro and dollar rates, ATMs, cards and cash, and how to pay in souks, taxis and hotels.
- [Tipping in Morocco: How Much to Tip](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/tipping-in-morocco/): How much to tip in Morocco: restaurants, cafés, taxis, hotels, guides and drivers, with rough amounts in dirhams and simple etiquette.
- [SIM Card in Morocco: Where to Buy and Which to Choose](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/sim-card-in-morocco-and-artisan-factories/): SIM card in Morocco: the main operators, where to buy a tourist SIM, what you need, eSIM option, coverage in cities and the desert, and simple tips.
- [Is Morocco Safe? The Honest Safety Guide](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/is-morocco-safe/): Is Morocco safe to visit? What to expect in cities, the desert and the mountains: petty theft, scams, solo women, driving and practical tips for a safe trip.
- [What to Wear in Morocco: The Packing Guide](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/what-to-wear-in-morocco/): What to wear in Morocco: modest dress for cities and mosques, layers for the desert and mountains, what women and men should pack in every season, and shoes.
- [Alcohol in Morocco: Rules, Where to Drink and Tips](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/alcohol-in-morocco/): Is alcohol legal in Morocco? Rules for visitors, where to drink in hotels, bars and shops, Ramadan, bringing alcohol in, Moroccan wine and beer, and practical tips.
- [What Time Is It in Morocco? Time Zone Guide](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/what-time-is-it-in-morocco-now/): What time is it in Morocco? Morocco generally uses GMT+1, with a one-hour change during Ramadan. Compare with Europe and the US, and plan your trip.
- [What Language Is Spoken in Morocco?](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/language-spoken-in-morocco/): What language is spoken in Morocco? Arabic and Amazigh are official, Darija is spoken daily, French and English help travellers. Useful phrases and tips.
- [Morocco Population: Key Facts for Travellers](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/morocco-population/): Morocco's population is about 37 million people. Learn about the biggest cities, urban and rural life, languages and what it means for travellers.
- [Ferry from Spain to Morocco: Routes, Times and Tips](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/ferry-from-spain-to-morocco/): Ferry from Spain to Morocco: main routes from Tarifa and Algeciras to Tangier, crossing times, documents, cars and booking tips, plus private tours from Tangier.
- [Religion in Morocco: What Travellers Should Know](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/religion-in-morocco/): Religion in Morocco: Islam is the state religion, with Jewish and Christian communities. Learn about mosques, prayer times, Ramadan, Friday and travel etiquette.
- [Moroccan Hammam: What to Expect](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/moroccan-hamam/): Moroccan hammam guide: traditional or spa, what happens step by step, black soap and ghassoul, what to bring, etiquette and tips for first-timers.
- [Tadelakt: Morocco's Polished Plaster](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/tadelakt/): Tadelakt is a traditional Moroccan lime plaster, polished with stone and sealed with soap. Learn how it is made, where it is used and where to see or buy it.
- [Traditional Moroccan Clothing: A Simple Guide](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/traditional-moroccan-clothing/): Traditional Moroccan clothing explained: djellaba, kaftan, takchita, gandoura, babouches and the Amazigh turban, with when each is worn and what to buy.
- [Amazigh People of Morocco: Culture and Travel](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/amazigh-people/): Who are the Amazigh (Berber) people of Morocco? Their languages, traditions, crafts and the regions where you can meet them, with respectful travel tips.
- [Moroccan Food: 10 Dishes to Try](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/cuisine-in-morocco/): Moroccan cuisine for travellers: tagine, couscous, pastilla, harira and mint tea, with where to eat, street food tips and dietary notes.
- [Fantasia Show in Marrakech: What to Expect](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/fantasia-show-marrakech/): The fantasia, or tbourida, is a traditional Moroccan horse show with riders and gunpowder salutes. Learn what to expect at a fantasia dinner show near Marrakech.
- [Movies Filmed in Morocco: Locations You Can Visit](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/movies-filmed-in-morocco/): Movies and series filmed in Morocco: Lawrence of Arabia, Gladiator, Kingdom of Heaven and Game of Thrones, with the locations you can visit near Ouarzazate.
- [Erg Chebbi vs Erg Chigaga: Which to Choose?](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/erg-chebbi-vs-erg-chigaga/): Erg Chebbi or Erg Chigaga? Compare access, dunes, camps, crowds and trip length to choose the best Sahara desert experience in Morocco.
- [Beaches in Morocco: Best Coastal Towns and When to Go](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/beaches-in-morocco/): The best beaches in Morocco: Essaouira, Agadir, Taghazout, Asilah and the Mediterranean coast, with surf, wind, swimming tips and the best season.
- [Asilah, Morocco: What to See and Do](https://favoritesmoroccotours.com/asilah-morocco/): Asilah guide: a whitewashed coastal town near Tangier with murals, ramparts and a beach. What to see, how to get there and how long to stay.
